in_marathi.name: Hukmaram
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hukmaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Hukmaram is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Hukm' meaning command, order, rule or law and 'Maram' meaning death or mortal. This name signifies that the person is someone who carries the command of God or is someone who is ruling by the command of God.
